game.title: Ni no Kuni: Wrath of the White Witch Remastered
game.blurb: Remaster of the Ni no Kuni: Wrath of the White Witch role-playing game, from Level 5, released 2019-09-19. RAWG average playtime: 4 hours. Genres: RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: Crossing to another world and the big story milestones, mostly hidden. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Familiars
chapters.summary: Taming species, metamorphoses, raising familiarity and training familiars to their full potential.

chapters.title: Errands and Bounty Hunts
chapters.summary: Running errands for people and completing bounty hunts, with hidden goals for doing many of them.

chapters.title: Alchemy, Treasure and Exploration
chapters.summary: Alchemizing items, finding every hidden treasure chest and visiting every secluded region.

chapters.title: The Casino and the Solosseum
chapters.summary: Casino prizes and the Solosseum, with hidden goals for each.

chapters.title: Spells, Songs and Battles
chapters.summary: Learning every spell, song and trickshot, plus guilders, stealing, glims and winning 1,000 battles.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). This is the 2019 remaster, with its own Steam app 798460; the Steam schema calls it "PLANET" (an internal codename) and the store list confirms the app. RAWG keeps the 2011 original as a separate entry. StrategyWiki has no page under "Ni no Kuni: Wrath of the White Witch" or "Ni no Kuni: Wrath of the White Witch Remastered". ninokuni.fandom.com has no page for the Remastered title but answers under "Ni no Kuni: Wrath of the White Witch" with about 28 linked articles; names only were looked at, nothing copied. 15 of 33 Steam achievements are hidden. Seven hidden ones near the top of the list (after "Out of this World") fall from 64.9% to 3.6% and look like story milestones, so they sit in the story chapter. The other eight were placed by where they sit in the Steam list, next to visible ones on the same theme: "Familiarologist" with familiars; "Humanitarian of the Year", "Bounty Hunter" and "Super Hero" with errands and bounties; "Mad Scientist" with alchemy; "High Roller" and the two Solosseum ones with the casino. These placements are guesses and need checking.
